conditions.runtime: Kaleidoscope End and matching JEMCompat are installed on client and logical server

change.summary: Add a persistent server-authoritative Void Walker on/off control

modifiers.before: The equipped enchantment is always active and JEMCompat only clears fall accumulation over its air support
modifiers.after: F7 in the JEM Compat controls category toggles the equipped enchantment's native air collision, jump lock and JEMCompat fall support together. Enabled remains the default

rationale.purpose: Let a player intentionally disable Void Walker without removing enchanted boots
rationale.decision_source: User confirmed this is an enchantment toggle, requested any free F key, then specified the Compat controls section. The pre-change test jem snapshot showed F7 free, so Codex selected F7 and preserved enabled-by-default behavior

introduced.summary: Add the F7 Void Walker toggle after capturing current test jem controls

history.summary: Add key registration, synchronized persistent state and narrow native mixin redirects

relations: Kaleidoscope End retains enchantment registration and native mechanics
JEMCompat owns only toggle state and compatibility interception
notes: The toggle refuses to change state when Void Walker is not equipped
The exact pre-change test jem controls are preserved under Docs/releases/2026-10-29-test-jem-controls-before-void-walker
